title: Crisp Weekend Meadow Lift

diffuser.notes: Run 30–45 min in a bright room; open a window for extra freshness.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; avoid spraying on skin or near eyes.

why_it_works: Lemon’s bright lift meets rosemary’s green clarity and a soft herbal hint of clary sage—airy but grounded for a crisp autumn morning.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
